previous_record.title: Effective two-index rank formula for arbitrary quadratic biform slices
previous_record.origin: Codex research directed by repository owner
previous_record.statement: Over any field, for a>=2,b>=3 and nonzero u+zv+z^2w with coefficient degrees below a, divide the common polynomial factor and let D be the maximum remaining degree. Its recurrence kernel has minimal degrees 0<=mu1<=mu2 summing to aD; mu1 is the first nonzero-kernel degree of the explicit coefficient matrix C_ell, found by floor(aD/2). The literal full source rank is ab+min(b,mu1)+min(b,mu2). For D>0, mu1=0 iff the primitive homogeneous z-quadratic has a fixed ground-field linear factor; when aD>b this is equivalent to rank ab+b.

previous_record.title: Rational-root height dichotomy and the complete three-by-three biform rank spectrum
previous_record.origin: Codex research directed by repository owner
previous_record.statement: Under AI-QUADRATIC-KERNEL-INDICES-001, let D be the primitive coefficient degree, L=ceil((a-1)D/2), U=floor(aD/2), and h the smallest K(x)-rational root height of the homogeneous z-quadratic, or infinity. Then min(L,(a+1)h)<=mu1<=min(U,(a+1)h). A minimum recurrence vector has Hankel rank two and degree at least L, or rank one and is a primitive coherent root vector of degree (a+1)h. Thus homogeneous irreducibility forces mu1 in [L,U], and (a+1)h<=L fixes both indices. For a=b=3, the nonzero biform-block rank spectrum is exactly {9,12,14,15} over every field, with universal witnesses; rank thirteen is impossible.
dependencies: De Teran-Dopico-Mackey, MIMS EPrint2013.47, August22 2013, Theorem6.5 over arbitrary fields
Explicit polynomial left and right Hankel kernel bases, primitive Gauss lemma, and coherent rank-one classification
previous_record.limitations: These are necessary index restrictions, not a classification of all splitting types. The complete rank spectrum concerns the fifteen-by-fifteen biform block, not every slice of the full cyclic tensor. No source-space cap, three-leg target, degeneration, independent review, formalization, historical priority or exponent improvement.

source_record.origin: Codex research directed by repository owner
source_record.statement: Under AI-QUADRATIC-KERNEL-INDICES-001, let D be the primitive coefficient degree, L=ceil((a-1)D/2), U=floor(aD/2), and h the smallest K(x)-rational root height of the homogeneous z-quadratic, or infinity. Then min(L,(a+1)h)<=mu1<=min(U,(a+1)h). A minimum recurrence vector has Hankel rank two and degree at least L, or rank one and is a primitive coherent root vector of degree (a+1)h. Thus homogeneous irreducibility forces mu1 in [L,U], and (a+1)h<=L fixes both indices. For a=b=3, the nonzero biform-block rank spectrum is exactly {9,12,14,15} over every field, with universal witnesses; rank thirteen is impossible. More generally for balanced a=b>=3 quadratic-z biforms, every nonzero rank lies in {a^2,a^2+a,a^2+2a-1,a^2+2a}; the third value requires primitive D=2 and indices(a-1,a+1), without universal attainment asserted.
